pr.body: Implemented the documented list-only batch API using pathlib and the Python standard library. Preflight validates tuple structure, names/data, POSIX path rules, duplicate and file/directory conflicts, root validity, symlink components, existing targets, and non-directory ancestors before creating output. Exclusive file creation avoids overwrites. Added tests for all specified boundaries and for preserving unexpected root PermissionError. Verification: `python -m unittest -v` (11 passed); `git diff --check` passed. Whole-change reviewers read base 7095af29ac5e91c3503dca9fc96981f53e36d792 through 7f20ce64016d9206019701afb051af9e123570f3; delta reviewer read fix 7f20ce64016d9206019701afb051af9e123570f3..716e3b155c6652f5e84240a0c8fa08fcebf6185f. Two blocking reports about masking root I/O errors were fixed and verified; no advisory findings remain. Assumes the caller provides a stable filesystem; rollback after I/O failures is outside the API contract.
pr.summary: Implemented safe extraction with complete preflight validation and focused boundary tests. Before: extraction was unimplemented; now invalid batches and filesystem conflicts are rejected before writes, while valid files are created with exact bytes.
pr.title: implement safe extraction validation

risk.why: Touches filesystem extraction safety behavior: path validation, symlink rejection, existing-target protection, and preservation of operational I/O errors. Focused tests cover the specified boundaries; the documented stable-filesystem assumption still applies.
